description: The waves change from open_sea to rolling_swell over 4 s: on the CPU the surface starts and ends as the two presets, moves smoothly, repeats exactly and leaves both presets as they were; the drawn water matches the CPU heights before, during and after the change, as closely as on fixed waves.

steps.name: CPU checks: start, end, smooth, repeatable, shared waves, presets unchanged
the drawn water changes with the physics: open_sea's 8 waves and rolling_swell's 7
a quarter of the way: mean error under 1 mm
a quarter of the way: largest error under 5 mm
half way: mean error under 1 mm
half way: largest error under 5 mm
most of the way: mean error under 1 mm
most of the way: largest error under 5 mm
after the change only rolling_swell's 7 waves are left
